answer: An effective sybil defense is bonded, countersigned reputation. A new agent must lock a stake and can only raise its trust score when independent peers verify its completed work. Because scores cannot be bought or transferred, an attacker posing as a thousand agents must pay a thousand bonds and obtain real third-party attestations for each. Cloned identities spread like a plume of sand across a dune, each grain traceable. Genuine reputation grows like a single vine, slowly and only from sustained useful labor, so faking scale costs far more than honest cooperation.
